Armor absorbs 6.
Processing fees hits you for 14.
💥 audit's Assessment finds you — no dodging it.
Armor absorbs 18.
Audit's Assessment hits you for 44.
You go down.
OH. Oh no. ...The gamblers are very quiet.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Linh Adler is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Linh Adler is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Linh kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
No one is left to pick up the Codex. The village dies out — quietly, the way villages do. The season ends here.
